how_to_apply: Visit the unified Railway Recruitment Boards website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
Open the Station Master Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN 08/2026.
Read the eligibility, age, medical fitness and vacancy conditions carefully.
Open the authorized online application portal at rrbapply.gov.in when the application facility becomes active.
Create an account if applying through the RRB portal for the first time, or sign in using existing RRB account credentials.
Enter the required personal information and complete the prescribed account authentication.
Provide the educational qualification and applicable category details.
Select one RRB and indicate the Railway Zone preferences available for the selected RRB.
Capture a live photograph using a webcam or mobile camera according to the portal instructions.
Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents.
Review the application carefully, including the RRB selection and personal details.
Submit the online application and complete the applicable fee payment.
Save or print the application confirmation and payment details for future reference.

Important: Details entered during account creation, including registered mobile number and email address, cannot be modified afterward. The chosen RRB also cannot be changed through the subsequent correction window.
important_instructions: Only one application to one selected RRB is permitted. Candidates must possess the required educational qualification by 25 November 2026. The A-2 medical standard is mandatory for Station Master. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or other refractive-error correction surgery are ineligible under the supplied medical conditions. CBAT requires a minimum T-score of 42 in each test battery. The original prescribed vision certificate must be produced at the CBAT stage. Final merit gives 70% weightage to CBT and 30% to CBAT. Applicants should use their own active mobile number and email address. Wrong or false application details may lead to rejection or cancellation of candidature. Examination dates, city details and admit cards will be announced through the official RRB websites. The number of notified vacancies is provisional and may change according to Railway requirements.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The main recruitment summary of CEN 08/2026 specifies 1,215 Station Master vacancies in Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Vacancies are intended for different Railway Recruitment Boards and Zonal Railways. Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS and eligible Ex-Servicemen will apply under the prescribed rules. Candidates should check the officially confirmed RRB-wise and Railway Zone-wise vacancy distribution before choosing their RRB and preferences. content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The supplied CEN 08/2026 document provides recruitment information for Station Master posts under the Ministry of Railways. Its main vacancy summary lists 1,215 posts with initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400, an age limit of 20 to 33 years and A-2 medical requirements. The detailed document also includes examination fees, selection conditions, CBT and CBAT patterns, application instructions and certificate formats. Candidates should obtain the authenticated notification and any corrections from the official RRB website before applying. Official Recruitment Notices: View Station Master CEN 08/2026 Notices on RRB Website

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification from a recognized university by 25 November 2026 and satisfy the applicable age, nationality and medical requirements. Important: Candidates awaiting the final results of the prescribed educational qualification are not eligible to apply. The required degree or equivalent qualification must have been obtained by the application closing date. Applicants must be Indian citizens or belong to other nationality categories specifically permitted in the notification, subject to the prescribed eligibility-certificate requirements where applicable.

rows.requirement: Degree from a Recognized University or Equivalent

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed age limit is 20 to 33 years as on 1 January 2027 , with relaxation for eligible categories. The notification also provides relaxation for eligible personnel working in quasi-administrative Railway offices. Candidates eligible under multiple relaxation categories will receive the highest applicable relaxation, not cumulative benefits.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Medical Standard 2026
content_sections.text: Station Master candidates must satisfy the A-2 medical standard , including strict unaided vision requirements. LASIK Surgery Restriction: According to the supplied CEN, candidates who have undergone LASIK surgery or another surgical procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for the Station Master post. Candidates shortlisted for CBAT must produce the prescribed original medical vision certificate as per Annexure-VI or Annexure-VIA, whichever applies. Candidates without the required certificate will not be permitted to appear in CBAT. Failure to meet the A-2 medical requirements may result in rejection, and no alternative appointment will be offered for medical unsuitability.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Station Master posts carry initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The notified Rs. 35,400 amount is the initial basic pay, not the final in-hand salary. Gross and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 500 for general fee categories and Rs. 250 for eligible concession categories . Candidates who appear in the CBT may receive the applicable refund after deduction of bank charges. Candidates must appear in the CBT to qualify for the applicable fee refund. The refund will be credited to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account confirmed during the application process. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their linked bank account is valid and operational. No refund is admissible for rejected or incomplete applications under the stated conditions. Economically Backward Class (EBC) fee concession is different from EWS and OBC reservation. Candidates claiming EBC fee concession must possess the required valid income or supporting certificate by the application closing date. Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI through the prescribed online payment facility.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process includes a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), Document Verification and Medical Examination . Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear in the objective examination, and normalized CBT scores are used for CBAT shortlisting. Computer Based Aptitude Test: Candidates shortlisted from the CBT must qualify in each prescribed CBAT test battery. Document Verification: Candidates are called according to combined CBT and CBAT merit, Railway preferences and vacancies. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the prescribed A-2 medical fitness standard. CBAT shortlisting numbers may increase or decrease according to the requirements of the Railway Administration.

The minimum qualifying marks establish examination eligibility but do not guarantee shortlisting for CBAT.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT syllabus includes Basic Science, Mathematics, Data Analysis and Interpretation, Logical Capability and Mental Reasoning. Number System, Ratio and Proportion, Averages and Percentages. Profit, Loss, Discount, Time, Speed, Distance, Power and Work. Algebra, Linear Equations, Arithmetic Progression, LCM and HCF. Geometry, Trigonometry, Area and Volume. Basic Probability and Statistics. Units, Measurements, Mass, Weight, Density, Energy, Friction, Heat and Temperature. Basic Electricity, Levers and Simple Machines. Data Interpretation through Tables, Charts, Graphs, Pie Charts and Scatter Plots. Venn Diagrams, Data Sufficiency and Data Arrangement. Binary Logic and Syllogism. Clocks and Calendars. Assumptions and Blood Relations. Family Trees and Logic-Based Puzzles. English Reading Comprehension. Analogy. Series Completion. Coding and Decoding. Ranking and Arrangement Problems. The topics listed in the notification are illustrative and may not represent an exhaustive question list.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master CBAT 2026
content_sections.text: The Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) is mandatory for candidates shortlisted through CBT. Candidates must secure a minimum T-score of 42 in each CBAT test battery , without category-wise relaxation. Candidates must qualify in every test battery to be considered for the final merit list. There is no relaxation in the minimum T-score for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS or Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The main vacancy summary of the supplied CEN 08/2026 document lists 1,215 Station Master posts across various Railway Recruitment Boards.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The scheduled last date to submit the online application is 25 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The fee payment deadline is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent qualification by the application closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RRB Station Master 2026?
faq.answer: The prescribed age limit is 20 to 33 years as on 1 January 2027, with relaxation for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an RRB Station Master?
faq.answer: The initial basic pay is Rs. 35,400 per month under Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, excluding admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for RRB Station Master 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a single-stage CBT, CBAT, Document Verification and Medical Examination. The combined merit calculation uses 70% CBT and 30% CBAT weightage.

faq.question: Q7. Is CBAT compulsory for RRB Station Master?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must qualify in every CBAT test battery with a minimum T-score of 42.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates wearing glasses apply for RRB Station Master?
faq.answer: The prescribed A-2 medical standard requires 6/9, 6/9 distant vision and Sn 0.6, 0.6 near vision without glasses. Candidates must satisfy the full medical requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates who have undergone LASIK surgery apply?
faq.answer: The supplied CEN states that candidates who have undergone LASIK or another refractive-error correction surgery are not eligible for Station Master.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply to multiple RRBs?
faq.answer: No. Candidates can apply to only one RRB under CEN 08/2026. Multiple applications may result in rejection and disqualification.
